decision: P2 upheld; draft held, no ready trigger
root_fresh_refutation: Permitted string IDs match F followed by whitespace and positive digits. Count and marker admission normalize whitespace, but returned citations retain raw n. Rail forwards it. Renderer byN uppercases n only and answer lookup strips whitespace, so a spaced admitted ID never becomes a chip. This is within the complete PR boundary even though the immediately previous incremental diff did not introduce it.
correction_scope: Strip whitespace from accepted stored string IDs, preserve numeric IDs and current lowercase return semantics. Existing stream owner controls natural failure and corrected renderer handoff; no backend/prompt/scorer change.
